decision.reason: [ev-5bbbbea35c34] clearly says the `crossplane xpkg login` and `crossplane xpkg logout` commands were removed, so change type "removed" is right. The subject is the problem: these are CLI subcommands, not flags. The cli-flag family is defined as a flag name with a leading "--", and no other listed family covers a subcommand. The proposed subject also names only `login`, but the same upstream change removes `logout` too. I can't write a correct subject using the allowed vocabulary, so I'm deferring this to a human or to a fix in the vocabulary rather than forcing it into the wrong family.
